item.title: Hegseth Announces 20% Cut to Generals and Admirals
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Wednesday that the military is implementing a 20% reduction in general and admiral positions.

item.title: Using a 401(k) to buy gold: what investors should know
item.description: A 401(k) can offer a route to gold investing, but the process and risks demand careful consideration.

item.title: WNBA playoffs: Fever force Game 3, Liberty advance
item.description: ABC News' Lara Spencer covers the high-octane matchups, including the New York Liberty eliminating the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx.

item.title: Snow leopard cub unveiled at Bronx Zoo
item.description: The Bronx Zoo revealed a new snow leopard cub named Sarka, which means "shark" in Nepali.
